{{Quote|More tests?''"<br/>"''You haven't worked for the Hutt as long as I have. If I could make this crew do it, I'd be running diagnostics all day and all night. I've seen the Hutt execute a crewman because a shutter squeaked.|Mal Hyb and Barada|<ref name="Quay" />}}
'''Mal Hyb''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] employed by [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] as an assistant to the [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] [[Barada/Legends|Barada]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], she worked on Jabba's [[Khetanna/Legends|sail barge]] with Barada in the hanger of [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. When the [[Klatooinian]] said they would perform another check on the vehicle after their break, Hyb was disappointed and walked away from him. 

==Biography==
{{Quote|Anything else?''"<br/>"''All the diagnostic tests turned up green.''"<br/>"''All right, let's take an hour for lunch. We'll check out the barge again later, before the Hutt gets here.|Barada and Mal Hyb|<ref name="Quay" />}}
[[File:BaradaECG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Mal Hyb was an assistant to Barada (pictured).]]
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates {{StoryCite|story=The Great God Quay: The Tale of Barada and the Weequays|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}} to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> Mal Hyb worked for<ref name="Quay" /> the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]<ref name="EGC">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> as an assistant to the [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] [[Barada/Legends|Barada]].<ref name="Quay" /> During one [[Local day/Legends|midday]] that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Hyb and Barada worked on the Hutt's [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]],<ref name="Quay" /> the ''[[Khetanna/Legends|Khetanna]]'',<ref name="CCS">''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]''</ref> inside the hanger of [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]], located on<ref name="Quay" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Later that day, Jabba would be setting out on the sail barge for<ref name="Quay" /> the execution of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] members [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].<ref name="EGC" />

After Barada installed an [[AE-35]] unit on the ''Khetanna'', Hyb let him know that the diagnostic tests for the sail barge turned up green, making<ref name="Quay" /> the [[Gender/Legends|man]]<ref name="EGC" /> order that they and his crewmen take a lunch break for an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]], then perform another check of the sail barge. The statement made a disappointed Hyb frown. Seeing this, Barada notified his assistant that at one point he witnessed Jabba execute a [[Unidentified crewman (Barada)|crewman]] because of a squeaking shutter, though the statement only made Hyb shake her head and walk away.<ref name="Quay" />

==Personality and traits==
Hyb was a compactly built [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Quay" /> who stood two [[Foot/Legends|feet]] below Barada's height of 1.7 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. She was disappointed when Barada stated another test would be done on the ''Khetanna''.<ref name="Height" />

==Skills and abilities==
Hyb was a capable assistant and was recognized in the palace's workshop for her skilled [[Welding torch/Legends|welding torch]] usage. The Human would have been a good accomplice when [[Unarmed combat/Legends|melee fighting]] as her talent would always surprise her opponent, though only once.<ref name="Quay" />

==Equipment==
She held a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] after a diagnostic was ran on the ''Khetanna''.<ref name="Quay" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mal Hyb appeared in "[[The Great God Quay: The Tale of Barada and the Weequays]]," a short story included in the anthology book ''[[Tales from Jabba's Palace]].'' The story was written by [[George Alec Effinger]]<ref name="Quay" /> and released in [[1995]].<ref name="Penguin-Paperback">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/3549/tales-from-jabbas-palace-star-wars-legends-by-kevin-anderson-editor/9780553568158|text=Tales from Jabba's Palace: Star Wars Legends}}</ref>
